(a) factorized learning is the best approach for learning over normalized data, but (b) there are cases when factorized learning can be slower than other alternatives, and hence a cost-based approach is necessary, and (c) factorized learning can also be extended to multi-table joins and Hive, but (d) there are some limitations to this extension.
